purpose: Teach: 同性/宣教師/レッテル/滅び/検察庁/結社/投融資/自虐

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、同性カップルの医療相談を医療チームで担当いたしました
lines.en: Ren, I handled the medical consultation for a same-sex couple with our medical team.
lines.style: Clear, steady delivery. Professional confidence without coldness. A simple statement of fact — matter-of-fact pace. Level, direct eye contact held across the line.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、海外宣教師の医療支援を医療チームで担当しました
lines.en: Yes, we handled medical support for overseas missionaries as a team.
lines.style: Calm affirmation. Slight pause before the substantive part. Measured cadence. The tone of someone who's answered this thoughtfully before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 特定の病気にレッテルを貼らぬよう、貴院、ご指導されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital guides against labeling patients by specific diagnoses, I notice, Doctor.
lines.style: Genuine intellectual curiosity, not testing. Thoughtful pace with respect for the question. Slight uplift at the end — seeking understanding, not challenging.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、文化が滅びる前の口承医療を医療チームで記録しております
lines.en: Yes, we document oral medical traditions before cultures disappear — it's part of our team's work.
lines.style: Direct and present. The weight of the purpose lands quietly. No performance, just clarity. A pause before 'cultures disappear' — the stakes are understood.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 検察庁からの医療事案の照会を、貴院、対応されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital responds to medical case inquiries from the prosecutor's office, I understand, Doctor.
lines.style: Observant, not accusatory. The question lands gently but lands. Steady tone. He's noticed something and is thinking aloud, carefully.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、秘密結社的団体の医療被害も医療チームで把握します
lines.en: Yes, we document medical harm even from secretive groups — our team handles that too.
lines.style: Unflinching clarity. No flinch at the difficult subject matter. Even tone, professional resolve. The word 'even' carries weight without emphasis.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療投融資の動向を、貴院、注視されているそうですね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital is monitoring medical investment and financing trends closely, I hear, Doctor.
lines.style: Thoughtful observation, almost to himself. Slower pace — he's piecing something together. Respectful but not deferential. The question carries quiet weight.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、自虐傾向の患者さんへの心理ケアを医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, we handle psychological care for patients with self-harm tendencies as a team.
lines.style: Steady, compassionate without sentiment. The subject matter deserves care in delivery. Even pace, warm but professional. A gentle closing — understands the vulnerability.
